verdict.rationale: Square documents broad API coverage across the main seller functions: payments, catalog, inventory, orders, locations, disputes, payouts, Terminal checkout options such as tipping, team management, customers and webhooks. It also ships official SDKs and an MCP server. However, nothing in the evidence claims or demonstrates that the API matches everything sellers can do in the Square Dashboard, so full UI parity is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or coverage matrix, evidence for Dashboard-only features (e.g. cash-flow/banking tools, payroll execution, settings), and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
